fingerprintMethod: SHA-256 of the repository canonicalJson(question), as exported by patternly-content/scripts/build.mjs; answer resolved by answer.optionId.
identityPolicy: Preserve question ID when the same item-level primary decision and accepted-answer intent remain; do not infer identity from unit label alone. Current exact-answer text receives fresh option IDs where its meaning changed.

finding.basis: The contents are an item-level repair of the same case and objective; current scenario-specific decisions are applications of the same original accepted decision, so the reserved replacement IDs are not justified by a primary-intent/archetype change. The current answer meanings do change from the generic prior option and use fresh per-item option IDs, which is appropriate.
finding.smallestCorrection: Restore each corresponding before question ID (i001–i018) while retaining the current item-specific answer IDs and text. Keep the reserved IDs unused. Recheck bindings after that metadata correction.
advisories: The proposed current question IDs use reserved i019–i036 even though these are same-item repairs; this is the sole blocking identity issue in this unit.
Length/key position are descriptive only; no threshold is applied.
